config.relaylyrics.bridge.prompt: Download the Lyrica bridge from GitHub to detect music from Windows media notifications. Without it, connect a supported player to look up lyrics.
config.relaylyrics.bridge.setup: Install the bridge manually from GitHub to detect music from Windows media notifications. You can also connect a supported player to look up lyrics.
config.relaylyrics.bridge.ready: Bridge installed. Restart Minecraft to enable Windows media detection.
config.relaylyrics.bridge.failed: Could not download the bridge for this version. Try again later.
karaoke.lyrica.no_song: Play a song before opening karaoke.
karaoke.lyrica.client_required: Install Lyrica on the client to use karaoke.
config.relaylyrics.popup_profile.desc: Each combination of media and lyrics remembers its own width and height.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.relaylyrics: Beautiful synchronized Spotify lyrics in Minecraft.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.relaylyri: Word-synchronized lyrics, smooth animation and customizable presentation. Configure Lyrica directly through Mod Menu.
screen.relaylyrics.subtitle: Synchronized Spotify lyrics
lyrics.relaylyrics.community_provided: These lyrics have been provided by our community

config.relaylyrics.spotify.failed: Could not start Spotify authorization. Check the client ID.
config.relaylyrics.line_animation.desc: Top to bottom fills the phrase vertically from the start to the end of its line timing. Timed fills the text horizontally over the phrase.
config.relaylyrics.animation_fps.desc: Limits lyric motion updates; playback timing stays synchronized.
config.relaylyrics.loading_skeleton.desc: Shows animated placeholders while lyrics are being searched.
config.relaylyrics.google_font.title: Google Fonts
config.relaylyrics.google_font.hint: Enter the exact family name from Google Fonts (for example: Inter or Noto Sans JP).
config.relaylyrics.google_font.invalid: Enter a valid Google Fonts family name.
config.relaylyrics.not_started: Start Minecraft once without Relay installed to initialize the standalone popup.
config.relaylyrics.start_spotify: Open Spotify and make sure the Relay Spicetify extension is installed.
config.relaylyrics.managed_by_relay.deta: Standalone rendering is disabled while the full Relay mod is installed, preventing duplicate popups.
lyrics.relaylyrics.dj_talking: Spotify DJ is talking. Lyrics return with the next song.
config.relaylyrics.audio_ducking.enabled: Temporarily lower selected apps in the Windows volume mixer.
config.relaylyrics.audio_ducking.trigger: Voice uses Plasmo Voice or Simple Voice Chat. Music keeps the app playing the track at its original volume.
Percentage of each app’s original volume.
config.relaylyrics.ji_afk_resume_music.d: With Ji AFK Cinematic, resume paused music when you go AFK and pause it again when you return.
config.relaylyrics.world_reposition.desc: Find another position when visible lyrics are blocked or leave the view.
config.relaylyrics.world_automatic.desc: Chooses a safe presentation for each phrase from terrain, duration, and speed.
config.relaylyrics.world_preset.desc: Locks one of six presentations when the automatic director is off.
config.relaylyrics.world_include.sign.de: Stands just above level ground with a contact shadow.
config.relaylyrics.world_include.mural.d: Follows a visible wall and projects the letters outward.
config.relaylyrics.world_include.engrave: Shallow relief on a nearly front-facing wall.
config.relaylyrics.world_include.monolit: Strong depth and bevel for short or sustained passages.
Places the next page ahead of the elytra trajectory.
config.relaylyrics.world_include.landsca: A distant horizon composition suited to running.
config.relaylyrics.world_surface_prefere: Use nearby walls when there is room. Fast movement keeps phrases ahead.
config.relaylyrics.world_material.desc: Changes the sides and edges while keeping the sung face easy to read.
config.relaylyrics.world_bevel.desc: Slants the edges of raised styles. Low quality disables this effect.
config.relaylyrics.world_bevel_width.des: Adjusts bevel width without rebuilding the mesh while drawing.
Projects a subtle shadow onto the ground beneath signposts.
config.relaylyrics.world_light.desc: Adapts side colors to the light where the phrase was placed.
config.relaylyrics.world_entrance.desc: Choose one motion or let the director match it to the style.
config.relaylyrics.inventory_content.des: Choose what appears in your inventory.
config.relaylyrics.additional_text.desc: Choose extra text; adjust its language and position in Romanization & translation.
config.relaylyrics.adjust_layout.hint: Drag to move; drag corner to resize. Arrows move; Shift + arrows resize. Hold Shift while dragging to align with centers, corners and other mods' interfaces.
config.relaylyrics.adjust_layout.desc: Drag the popup to move it. Resize freely from any edge or corner; videos take priority when space is limited.
config.relaylyrics.visual_style.desc: Choose classic cards or rounded corners for the popup.
config.relaylyrics.effects_preset.desc: Combine lyric glow, shadows and motion.
config.relaylyrics.background_preset.des: Kawarp warps the cover with the music. Artist image uses the profile header photo, falling back to the album cover.
config.relaylyrics.restore_appearance.de: Restore style, font, text size, alignment, effects and background. Position, music, connections and World 3D remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.preview.hint: Changes appear in the current song.
config.relaylyrics.music_app.desc: Automatically detects the song and playing app. Spotify account connection is optional.
config.relaylyrics.group.connection_deta: Manual method, Client ID, pairing and track identification. Connecting an account does not guarantee lyrics for every song.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.guide_opened: Folder opened and copied; read its README.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.guide_failed: Could not open the guide. Check the log.
config.relaylyrics.group.performance.des: Optional animation FPS limit and loading indication.
config.relaylyrics.group.interaction.des: Clicks, overlap, borders and numeric popup dimensions.
config.relaylyrics.group.effects.desc: Adjust glow, shadow and transitions individually. Changes may show Custom as the preset.
config.relaylyrics.group.background.desc: Available controls depend on the background selected in Appearance. Hidden values stay saved.
config.relaylyrics.group.experimental.de: Features under development, disabled by default.
config.relaylyrics.group.world.desc: Distance, participating presentations, volume, lighting and animations. Each group restore changes only its own preferences.
config.relaylyrics.restore_performance.d: Remove the FPS limit and disable the skeleton. Other settings remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.restore_effects.desc: Restore the Spicy glow, shadow and transition values. Font, size and the global animation switch remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.restore_background.de: Restore only background, music reactivity and artwork shadow.
config.relaylyrics.world_mode.desc: Automatic adapts the presentation to the environment. Fixed uses your selected presentation. Switching keeps the fixed choice saved.
config.relaylyrics.world_quality.desc: Controls geometry detail. Timing, glyph lift and terrain lighting work at every quality.
Restore surface, distance, sensitivity, crosshair gap and participating presentations. Popup position, material, animations, fixed mode and quality remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.world_reset_volume.de: Restore material, depth, bevel, lighting, contact shadow and colors. Quality, distance and animations remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.world_reset_animation: Restore World 3D entrance, intensity, speed and trails. The global animation switch remains unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.defaults.confirm: Restore appearance, font, position, lyrics, performance and World 3D? Accounts, Client ID, pairing and your connection method will be preserved.
config.relaylyrics.defaults.desc: Show a summary before restoring. Credentials, pairing and music source remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.demo.line2: Every word in its own time
config.relaylyrics.spotify.account.desc: Open setup, enter your Spotify Developer app Client ID and authorize the account in your browser. The required redirect appears on that screen. No client secret is requested.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.connect.desc: Open the companion folder. In Chrome or Edge, open Extensions, enable Developer mode and load this folder unpacked. Open music.youtube.com while the game is running. The folder README has full instructions.
config.relaylyrics.music_source.desc: Automatic follows the active system player and uses the Spotify account as a fallback. System media works without login with apps that publish playback controls.
config.relaylyrics.connection.method.des: Shows the source providing current playback: system media session, Spotify account or local extension.
config.relaylyrics.pinned.desc: Keep lyrics open while music plays.
config.relaylyrics.font.desc: Choose a typeface for the lyrics.
config.relaylyrics.alignment.desc: Align left, center, or respect the alignment supplied by the lyrics.
config.relaylyrics.animations.desc: Turn off for reduced motion. Video playback has its own switch.
config.relaylyrics.world_size.desc: Adjust the text size while respecting the available reading space.
config.relaylyrics.world_intensity.desc: Set how pronounced World 3D effects are. Choose Soft if motion makes reading difficult.
config.relaylyrics.world_preview.desc: Temporarily show a composition in the current world without changing music. Requires an open world.
config.relaylyrics.world_preview.no_worl: Enter a world to see the 3D preview.
config.relaylyrics.allow_gui_overlap.des: Allow the popup to overlap other interfaces. Disable to prioritize inventory readability.
config.relaylyrics.click_seek.desc: Click a lyric line to seek to that passage when supported by the connection.
config.relaylyrics.border.desc: Show a border around the popup.
config.relaylyrics.resize_grip.desc: Show the resize grip in the popup corner.
config.relaylyrics.width.desc: Popup width in GUI pixels. It can also be adjusted by dragging in General.
config.relaylyrics.height.desc: Popup height in GUI pixels. It can also be adjusted by dragging in General.
config.relaylyrics.reset_layout.desc: Restore only popup position and dimensions.
config.relaylyrics.weight.desc: Adjust the selected font weight. A Google font may need to load its new variant.
config.relaylyrics.simple.desc: Use the simple lyric presentation. The stored glow intensity applies again when this is disabled.
config.relaylyrics.glow.desc: Adjust the glow intensity of active words.
config.relaylyrics.transition.desc: Set lyric transition speed. Requires the global Animations switch.
config.relaylyrics.shadow.desc: Show text shadows. Disabling keeps opacity, distance and softness saved.
config.relaylyrics.shadow_opacity.desc: Set shadow strength without darkening the lyric face.
config.relaylyrics.shadow_distance.desc: Distance between glyphs and their shadows in pixels before text scaling.
config.relaylyrics.shadow_softness.desc: Choose a sharp, soft or broader shadow.
config.relaylyrics.opacity.desc: Popup background opacity. Text keeps its own contrast.
config.relaylyrics.cover_shadow.desc: Show a shadow beneath the album artwork.
config.relaylyrics.blur.desc: Soften the artwork details used by the background.
config.relaylyrics.speed.desc: Motion speed of the animated background.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_source.desc: Choose word progression or the audio signal supplied by the media bridge.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_intensity.de: Overall background reaction strength for the selected source.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_hue.desc: Allow background hue variation. Disabling keeps its settings.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_hue_auto.des: Allow continuous hue changes alongside musical reaction.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_bloom.desc: Allow light expansion in the reactive background.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_spectral.des: Allow colors to vary with available spectral content.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_spectral_amo: Strength of spectral background color variation.
config.relaylyrics.world_lyrics.desc: Place synchronized lyrics in the scenery. Turning this off preserves your style.
config.relaylyrics.group.typography.desc: Adjust font, size, alignment and additional text. Quick-setting choices remain available here.
config.relaylyrics.current_song.empty: Play a song to see your changes here.
config.relaylyrics.connection.setup.desc: View setup steps and status for the selected connection. Automatic also accepts local bridges without changing this option.
config.relaylyrics.connection.guide.wind: Play a song in an app that publishes system media controls. Detection is automatic and needs no Spotify account.
config.relaylyrics.connection.guide.spic: Install the Lyrica extension in Spicetify and use the code and port in Connection details.
config.relaylyrics.world_customize.desc: Open the World 3D group in Customize. The current song remains the lyric reference.
config.relaylyrics.effects_preset.custom: Open Customize to adjust glow, shadow and transitions individually.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.intro: Connect your Spotify account to read playback and match tracks for Spicy Lyrics. Your playback source stays unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.applica: 1. Open Spotify for Developers, create or select your application and copy its Client ID.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.redirec: Redirect URI copied. Save it in your Spotify Developer application settings.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.client: 3. Paste the Client ID below, then connect. No Client Secret is needed.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.browser: Approve access in your browser, then return here. The link is also copied so you can paste it into another browser. If Spotify rejects the request, check the Redirect URI and the application's allowed users.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.title: Connect YouTube Music
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.intro: Use the bundled Chrome / Edge companion to connect your YouTube Music tab. It sends playback locally and does not request your Google password.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.install: 1. Prepare the companion folder. Its path is copied automatically.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.extensi: 2. Copy the page address for your browser, paste it into the address bar and open it:
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.load: Enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked and select the prepared folder. Updating an existing installation? Click Reload on its extension card.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.play: 3. Open YouTube Music and play a song. Reload the tab if it was already open. Keep Minecraft running. Automatic mode also detects the companion.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.pairing: Pairing is automatic in this companion. If a compatible client asks for a code, copy the current code below.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.spicy: Lyrics are found automatically by title and artist across enabled sources without a Spotify account. The account below is optional for Spotify playback.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.waiting: Waiting for the YouTube Music companion…
config.relaylyrics.sources.import_ttml.d: Use a local TTML file for the current track. It stays saved until you clear the lyrics cache.
config.relaylyrics.sources.import_ttml.s: TTML saved for the selected track.
config.relaylyrics.sources.import_ttml.n: Start a song before importing TTML.
config.relaylyrics.sources.import_ttml.i: Choose a valid TTML file with lyrics (up to 4 MiB).
config.relaylyrics.sources.import_ttml.f: Could not open the file picker or save the TTML.
config.relaylyrics.connection.guide.auto: Play music in Spotify, YouTube Music or another player. The system media session is detected without login. Optionally connect a Spotify account in Connection details as a fallback.
Allows Spicy Lyrics lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
Allows AMLL TTML DB lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.unison.desc: Allows Unison lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
Allows Unison via Spicy Lyrics lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.rmm_revival.d: Allows RMM Revival lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.lrc_red.desc: Allows lrc.red lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.kugou.desc: Allows Kugou lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.qq_music.desc: Allows QQ Music lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.kuwo.desc: Allows Kuwo lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.netease.desc: Allows NetEase lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.lrclib.desc: Allows LRCLIB lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.lrcmux.desc: Allows LRCMux lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.genius.desc: Allows Genius lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.youtube_trans: Allows YouTube Transcripts lookups for this song. Sends song metadata; availability and timing depend on the source.
config.relaylyrics.sources.explanation.d: Finds lyrics by title and artist without a Spotify account. Prefers word timing and falls back across enabled sources.
Silent video loops, with a still cover when no video is available.
config.relaylyrics.motion.canvas.desc: Use the track Canvas when video playback is enabled.
config.relaylyrics.motion.animated_cover: Use animated album art when video playback is enabled.
config.relaylyrics.motion.background.des: Shows a dimmed Canvas behind the lyrics. Works independently of Canvas on the cover.
config.relaylyrics.motion.pause.desc: Freezes video when music is paused and continues when playback resumes.
config.relaylyrics.settings.title: Settings
config.relaylyrics.settings.subtitle: Lyrica
config.relaylyrics.group.source_priority: Fallback sources prefer word sync over line sync and plain text. Ties follow this order. Select a position to move a source.
A usable Spicy Lyrics response wins. Other providers fill in while it loads or if it is unavailable.
config.relaylyrics.motion.retry.desc: Retry discovery without changing songs, refreshing remembered results.
config.relaylyrics.world_style.desc: Uses the popup font. Presentation may be flat or have volume independently of its animation.
config.relaylyrics.world_accent.desc: Color of the glow and the light on the sung word.
config.relaylyrics.world_glow.desc: A soft halo follows the sung word.
config.relaylyrics.world_render_mode.des: Automatic adapts to Iris. Try Safe if a shader or font pack causes rendering problems.
config.relaylyrics.world_smooth_font.des: Use the included Inter font by default. A selected Google Fonts or Uniform font takes priority.
config.relaylyrics.world_position.desc: Keeps the crosshair clear. Elytra flight follows your trajectory with reading space ahead.
config.relaylyrics.world_luminance.desc: Minecraft light level from 0 to 15. Affects nearby blocks, not a halo around the text.
config.relaylyrics.world_terrain_light.d: Sung words emit real terrain light through LambDynamicLights 4.8+. Install it separately.
config.relaylyrics.world_depth.desc: Thickness of the closed glyph mesh.
See what other players on the same server are listening to.
config.relaylyrics.music_presence.enable: Tab icon, /music and an artwork card after looking for 3 seconds. Turning off also stops sharing.
config.relaylyrics.music_presence.sharin: Shares title, artist and a small cover thumbnail while music plays in multiplayer. No listening history.
config.relaylyrics.music_presence.status: Sign in to your Minecraft account to use presence
music_presence.disabled: Music Presence is disabled in settings.
music_presence.player_missing: Could not find %s on this server.
music_presence.not_listening: %s is not sharing a song right now.
music_presence.connecting: Music Presence is connecting; please try again shortly.
music_presence.sharing_requires_account: Your account can view music. To share yours, sign in with a verified Minecraft account.
config.relaylyrics.connection.auto.desc: Spotify, browsers and other system players. Open your app and play a song; no additional login.
config.relaylyrics.connection.auto.ready: Automatic detection enabled. Play a song in your music app.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.account_intro: Paste your app Client ID and authorize in your browser. Automatic detection also works without connecting an account.
Already set up? Paste and connect. For your first connection, expand the instructions below.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.no_link: Click Connect to generate a fresh authorization link.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.client_invali: Paste a valid Client ID. For the first connection, create an app and register the redirect address using the instructions below.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.account_intro: On Windows, try automatic detection first. For browser timing and controls, prepare the companion, load the extension and open YouTube Music.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.waiting: Waiting for YouTube Music in your browser
config.relaylyrics.spicy.key_missing: No key configured. Other lyrics sources remain available.
config.relaylyrics.spicy.key_configured: Key configured · checked when fetching lyrics
config.relaylyrics.spicy.key_input.desc: Use a client key (sl_pk_). This field is masked and only saved when you click Apply.
config.relaylyrics.spicy.key_invalid: Enter a valid public key starting with sl_pk_. Secret sl_sk_ keys are not accepted.
config.relaylyrics.spicy.key_saved: Key saved. Fetching lyrics again with your credential.
config.relaylyrics.spicy.key_removed: Personal key removed. A key configured in your environment can still be used.
config.relaylyrics.settings.zoom_hint: Ctrl + scroll to resize · Ctrl + 0 to reset
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.redirec: Paste the copied address into your app Redirect URI in Spotify Developer and save.
config.relaylyrics.popup_edge_docking.de: Drag to the top to become an island without releasing. While still holding, pull away to restore the popup. Releasing confirms the current form. Playback keeps the title; 5s paused without hover contracts it with a soft spring.
config.relaylyrics.group.island.desc: Customize the background and thumbnail of the top music island.
config.relaylyrics.island.kawarp.desc: On hover, swirls colors from the video or cover into a soft animated background. The compact island keeps its black background.
config.relaylyrics.island.video.desc: Uses Canvas or animated cover. In the collapsed capsule, video plays even while music is paused. With video or animations off, it shows the static photo.
config.relaylyrics.island.lyrics.desc: Replaces the title and bars with a single synced lyric row. Line lyrics scroll for the line's duration; word lyrics switch chunks as they are sung. Instrumental gaps show the title and waiting dots.
config.relaylyrics.island.jade.desc: Shows Jade content in an island below the music. Requires Jade.
config.relaylyrics.lyrics_delay.desc: Lyrics early? Increase (+). Lyrics late? Decrease (−). Adjust in 25 ms steps without changing playback.
config.relaylyrics.lyrics_delay_reset.de: Return to 0 ms. This saved adjustment also applies to world lyrics.
config.relaylyrics.group.gemini_shader.d: Transforms the landscape, colors and sky to suit the music. Experimental.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.privacy.desc: When enabled, sends title, artist, album, duration, available BPM and your visual direction to Google. No audio or lyrics. Uses your API key quota and billing. GLSL runs locally.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.enabled: Enable music shaders in the world
config.relaylyrics.gemini.enabled.desc: Gemini creates a treatment for the 3D scene: monochrome, vivid colors, different tones and sky. Menus, HUD and popup keep their original colors.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.key.desc: Paste a Google AI Studio key and click Save key. Stored locally in a separate unencrypted file, excluded from shader cache and exported preferences.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.key_saved: Gemini key saved on this computer.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.key_remove.des: Deletes the local key and disables the experiment.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.model.desc: Model ID, such as gemini-flash-latest. Choose a Gemini text model available to your account.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.direction.desc: Optional: supply an intention, cultural reference or visual mood as art direction. Applies to all tracks until changed.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.automatic.desc: Waits for the song to settle and reuses cached shaders. Turn off to generate only with the button below. New API calls are at least 20 seconds apart.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.quality.desc: The effect is smoothly enlarged to fit the popup. Lower resolution reduces GPU work.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.fps.desc: Caps only the shader, from 15 to 30 FPS. Lyrics keep their own timing and rendering rate.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.brightness.des: Lower it to make lyrics easier to read.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.regenerate.des: Bypasses the cached shader and makes a new Gemini request for the current song. Also works in manual mode.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.clear_cache.de: Deletes up to 64 cached shaders. Keeps your key and the current visual until the next song or regeneration.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.offline: The player has not started yet
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.key_miss: Add and save your Gemini key
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.key_inva: Invalid key, or the key could not be saved
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.waiting: Waiting for a stable playing song
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.ready: World GLSL ready · applies while playing in a world
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.cached: Using the cached world shader for this song
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.quota: Quota or rate limit reached · wait before regenerating
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.response: No compatible shader in the response · try generating another
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.network: Could not reach Gemini · check your connection
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.glsl: GLSL compilation failed · original world colors retained
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.gpu: Graphics effect unavailable · original world colors retained
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.gpu_slow: Effect unavailable · original world colors retained
config.relaylyrics.gemini.state.storage: Could not access the local file
config.relaylyrics.gemini.key.placeholde: Paste your key, then click Save key
config.relaylyrics.gemini.direction.plac: Example: monochrome world with a violet sky
config.relaylyrics.gemini.world_strength: 100% applies the complete musical look. Lower it to blend with the original landscape colors.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.art_style.desc: Automatic lets AI invent a treatment. A manually selected style becomes a visual constraint. Regenerate asks for a new concept for the same song.
Parallel treatment of the original scene, blended after the primary art. Does not alter glyph materials.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.art_blend.desc: How much secondary art is blended in. Overall strength mixes the result with the original world.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.art_scale.desc: Changes the on-screen size of hatching, halftone and paper texture.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.art_stroke.des: Edge detection thickness. Styles without outlines may ignore this parameter.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.art_grain.desc: Paper or pigment texture amount. Cel shading does not use grain.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.art_seed.desc: Varies the drawing without changing its technique. The same seed keeps the pattern stable.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.art_animated.d: Redraws the pattern in discrete 8 FPS steps. Off keeps strokes and paper static.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.art_audio.desc: Supplies available energy and bands to the shader. Off zeros these signals.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.art_recipe.des: Applies a ready-made combination. Every parameter remains editable. In manual mode, click Regenerate afterward.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.song_context.d: AI interprets title, artist, album and references it recognizes to create a visual identity for each song. No per-track rules or recording analysis.
config.relaylyrics.gemini.creative_freed: Higher values encourage bespoke composition, skies, apparent materials and atmosphere while keeping the musical reference and selected style.
config.relaylyrics.group.languages.desc: Read the original, its pronunciation and a translation together.
config.relaylyrics.group.translation_pro: Service, model and private API key.
config.relaylyrics.languages.open.desc: Choose the language and how extra text appears.
config.relaylyrics.romanization.mode.des: Keep the original visible or replace it with its pronunciation.
config.relaylyrics.romanization.desc: Show supplied pronunciation, with local transliteration when available.
config.relaylyrics.motion.videos.desc: Allow Canvas and animated covers, even with interface animations off.
config.relaylyrics.group.updates.desc: Find releases compatible with your Minecraft version.
config.relaylyrics.updates.automatic.des: Checks GitHub at startup and every six hours. Sends no song or account data.
config.relaylyrics.updates.prereleases.d: Also offer published prereleases for this Minecraft version.
config.relaylyrics.updates.status.desc: Only releases with a compatible Lyrica JAR are offered.
config.relaylyrics.updates.check.desc: Ask GitHub again; repeated checks are limited to once per 30 seconds.
config.relaylyrics.updates.open.desc: Open the release page to review changes and download the JAR.
config.relaylyrics.updates.state.failed: Could not check. Try again later.
config.relaylyrics.updates.notification: Lyrica %s is available. See Advanced → Updates for the download.
config.relaylyrics.group.support.desc: Copy a safe technical report or report a problem.
config.relaylyrics.support.privacy.value: Versions, platform, compatibility mods and playback settings. No keys, accounts, file paths or lyric text.
config.relaylyrics.support.copy.desc: Copy technical details to paste into your bug report.
config.relaylyrics.support.copied: Diagnostics copied. Add what happened and how to reproduce it.
config.relaylyrics.support.report.desc: Open Lyrica’s GitHub issue form in your browser.
Choose the language for newly generated translations.
config.relaylyrics.translation.automatic: Send lyrics to the selected service when a song loads. Off by default.
config.relaylyrics.translation.now.desc: Translate into the selected language without enabling automatic translation.
config.relaylyrics.translation.status.de: Translations are cached locally; failures keep the original lyrics.
Choose who receives and translates the lyrics.
config.relaylyrics.translation.key.desc: Stored locally in a separate unencrypted key file. Never included in diagnostics.
Save the key for the selected provider on this device.
config.relaylyrics.translation.key_remov: Remove the saved key for this provider.
config.relaylyrics.translation.model.des: Gemini: blank uses gemini-flash-latest. Compatible services require a model.
config.relaylyrics.translation.address.d: HTTPS base URL ending in /v1, or a complete chat/completions URL.
config.relaylyrics.translation.privacy.v: Machine translation sends lyric text to your selected service. API providers may charge your account. Existing lyric translations remain available with automatic translation off.
config.relaylyrics.translation.key_faile: Could not save or remove the key
config.relaylyrics.translation.key_missi: No saved key for this provider
config.relaylyrics.translation.state.idl: Use Translate or enable automatic translation
config.relaylyrics.translation.state.unn: No extra translation returned for this language
config.relaylyrics.translation.state.key: Add an API key in Translation provider
config.relaylyrics.translation.state.mod: Choose an AI model in Translation provider
config.relaylyrics.translation.state.fai: Could not translate. Check the key, service and model, then retry.
config.relaylyrics.world_direction.desc: Automatic works locally. Gemini sends the complete lyrics, timing and track metadata to Google to prepare direction; uses your API quota.
config.relaylyrics.world_presentation_in: Adjusts composition variety and movement strength. Spicy word and glyph motion stays active at Discreet intensity.
config.relaylyrics.world_cinematic.desc: Allows direction to place words in the center of the view. Off keeps the crosshair clear. Text remains fixed in the world.
config.relaylyrics.group.world_gemini.de: Optional experiment that interprets lyrics and prepares compositions per song, with its own key and settings.
config.relaylyrics.group.world_gemini.hi: Experimental · lyrics, timing and visual direction
With Gemini direction enabled, lyrics, original word timing, voices and track metadata are sent to Google. No audio or game images are sent. The API key is stored locally outside exported preferences.
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.key.plac: Paste a Google AI Studio API key
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.song_fon: Let Gemini choose Inter, Oswald, or Caveat for lyrics in the world.
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.directio: Example: quiet verses, falling words in the chorus
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.ke: Add a key to enable Gemini direction
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.ge: Preparing direction · local mode remains active
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.re: Direction ready · applies to new phrases
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.co: Waiting before another request · local mode active
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.au: Key rejected · check your Google API key
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.mo: Model unavailable · choose an available text model
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.qu: API quota reached · local mode active
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.re: Gemini rejected the request · local mode active
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.un: Gemini temporarily unavailable · local mode active
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.re: Invalid direction response · local mode active
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.ne: Could not reach Gemini · local mode active
config.relaylyrics.world_gemini.state.ke: Could not save this API key
config.relaylyrics.world_volumetric.desc: Gives all words actual volume without changing their composition or animation. Off keeps flat text; Gemini may still give selected words volume.
While World 3D is enabled, sends lyrics, timing and track data to Google to prepare direction. When off, uses local automatic composition.
